# b2c_tooling_sdk

Python SDK for Salesforce B2C Commerce tooling.

Mirrors the public surface of the `@salesforce/b2c-tooling-sdk` TypeScript SDK
and interoperates with the B2C CLI: it reads and writes the same persisted auth
sessions and configuration files. Top-level re-exports are grouped by subsystem
(auth, config, instance, clients, operations); submodules can also be imported
directly, e.g. `from b2c_tooling_sdk.auth import OAuthStrategy`.
